messages.subject: Compare to metabolomics instead of microbial abundance
parts:
Hi,

I was looking into using Maaslin on a targeted metabolomics dataset with multiple clinical variables. By looking at the requirements of Maaslin it looks like my data needs to be proportional to be able to use it. Just wanted to make sure I understood it correctly and that I would have to transform my data to make it proportional for each sample before trying to run it. 

Kind regards,

Brigida Rusconi

Brigida Rusconi, PhD  
Postdoctoral Fellow
